info.name: Get a charger by internal ID

params.name: id
params.description: The internal ID of the charger.

items.docs: Retrieve detailed information about a specific charger by its internal Flipturn ID, including ports, connection status, and any ongoing session.

info.name: Get a charger by external (network station) ID

params.name: id
params.description: The external ID (network station ID) of the charger.

items.docs: Retrieve a charger by its external network station ID. Response structure is identical to getCharger.

info.name: Get a charger by OCPP ID

params.name: id
params.description: The OCPP identifier of the charger.

items.docs: Retrieve a charger by its OCPP identifier. Response structure is identical to getCharger.
